partner_result_applied.scope_used: exact normalization of the sharp constant to s_3(A)=1 and smooth-generic boundary approximation

new_result: If an original-coordinate 2x2 principal block B is definite then ||p_{X^TAX}||_infinity <= pi/sqrt(|det B|), uniformly over all outside coefficients and admissible product inputs. If a third coordinate k is uncoupled from that pair and A_kk!=0, the output additionally has a C_0 representative with the same height cap.
counterexample_to_uniform_local_payment: A_m=diag(J_m/m,J_m/m,J_m/m) has spectrum {1,1,1}; every nonsingular definite physical 2x2 principal determinant is 1/m^2, so single-pair payment grows like pi m.
unresolved_implication: Replace reciprocal payment for one physical determinant by a dimension-free aggregate product-coordinate bank payment in the diffuse-minor regime.
